Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. NovaWorks was accepted into the Summer Sponsorship program and we're trying to lock the platform allowance and sketched onboarding commitments so engineering can proceed with the integration next week. A few specifics from our side:

- Target initial allowance: 100,000 token-equivalent starter allowance (to be consumed over first 45 days)
- Sandbox access: 45-day trial environment with extended logs/retention for debugging
- Commitment: two 45-minute product demos (one internal, one recorded for a joint case study) and a short post-launch metric check-in 30 days after go-live

Can Redwood confirm eligibility and whether the allowance requires an MSA or if a short TOS is sufficient? I attached our company deck for context (NovaWorks-deck.pdf). Also copying Legal Ops in case they need to review.

If this is straightforward we can sign quickly and schedule the onboarding call for next Thursday.

Thanks —
Evelyn

Hi Evelyn —

Congrats on the acceptance. We can support the allowance you requested. Proposed terms from our side: 

- Starter allowance: 100,000 token-equivalent (no charge)
- Trial window: 45 days of sandbox access with extended 30-day debug log retention
- Deliverables: two demos (one internal onboarding + one recorded joint demo) and a 30-day metric check-in
- Legal: for starter allowances <=100k tokens we typically use a short TOS (attached) rather than a full MSA; if Legal needs additional language we can accommodate but it may add 3–5 business days

I attached the Starter_Allowance_TOS.pdf with standard usage limits and data handling notes. If that looks good, please sign and return the attached PDF and we will generate the allowance code and provision the sandbox. Would you prefer onboarding on Thursday 8/1 or Friday 8/2 at 10am PT?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic GTM, Redwood Inference
